description.value: Mission Hills Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Chilliwack, BC, situated in the Fraser Valley — a popular corridor for touring cyclists travelling between Metro Vancouver and the Interior. It would offer cyclists a sit-down meal stop, though details about the dining experience, menu, and facilities are unavailable due to the compromised website.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website sushimissionhills.com returned a security-warning interstitial indicating the domain has been hijacked and redirected to a known malicious host (cf.miniroad.store); no actual restaurant content was retrievable, so all amenity fields default to null. OSM tags are minimal — only name and phone are present, with no address, cuisine tags, or amenity sub-tags. A hijacked or expired domain is a meaningful signal that the business may have closed and let its domain lapse, warranting needs_review rather than a confident include.
concerns: Website sushimissionhills.com is compromised — the domain redirects to a malicious third-party host (cf.miniroad.store) and returns a security-warning interstitial rather than restaurant content. This may indicate the domain has expired after the business closed.
No address in OSM tags; physical location cannot be verified.
Phone number +1-604-287-5590 could not be cross-confirmed via website due to domain compromise.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business domain appears to have been hijacked and redirects to a known malicious host, which often indicates the business has closed and allowed its domain to expire; OSM alone is insufficient to confirm the restaurant is still actively operating.
enrichment_extras.notes: Recommend a manual check (phone call or street-level verification) to confirm whether the restaurant is still operating before including in the directory.

wow_evidence: domain has been hijacked and redirected to a known malicious host
